# Premium acquisition C

Devolution is HOLD: retain prior code as opt-in, no further production. Naruto Online preferred for 6v6 art, Naruto Mobile supplemental. Public source catalogs are not animation metadata; numbered pieces must not be treated as whole cels. No rig, no gameplay edits, no merge. Normal public GET only, stop at login/403/payment. Public CI exports catalog and numeric review evidence, not copied source art. 

Local review: `python -m pip install Pillow==11.3.0`; download available ZIPs using normal source pages into a local folder, then `python art/external/premium_review.py inspect --input local-archives --out premium-local`. Contact sheets preserve original frames and provide stable hash IDs; embedded GIFs preserve frame durations. For separate PNGs, supply explicit verified action order and pixel anchors in selection JSON: {"clips":[{"name":"character-action","verified_frame_order":true,"complete_cels":true,"duration_ms":[100],"frames":[{"id":"20-hex-id","anchor":[48,104]}]}]}. Run `python art/external/premium_review.py gif --input premium-local --selection selection.json --out premium-local/gifs`. No fabricated frame order, no public publication without reuse rights.
